title: Execute hierarchical row/group-scale W4 candidate

fresh_attempt_namespace.execution_marker_creation_rule: Create atomically exactly once only after deterministic candidate A/B identity, legal 169-tensor hierarchical construction, strict aggregate fresh-V7 SSE improvement, 8/8 construction-blind non-evaluator exactness, 312 legal Dynamic Scale32 events, and complete hash verification produce PREATTEMPT_READY.json.

implementation_objective: Implement an isolated V8 runner and scalable backend that replace codebook-index weights and one Scale32 record per output row with signed-int4 weights, one four-bit tensor-table selector per row, one signed four-bit exponent delta per contiguous 128 weights, and one sixteen-entry Scale32 base table per Linear tensor while preserving grouped Dynamic Scale32 A8 and the public ace2_shell contract.

required_constructor.weight_payload: signed int4 -8 through +7 packed low nibble first
required_constructor.row_base_selector: one unsigned four-bit selector per output row into a tensor-local sixteen-entry strictly increasing Scale32 table
required_constructor.group_exponent_delta: one signed four-bit two's-complement exponent delta -8 through +7 per contiguous 128 weights
required_constructor.effective_scale: selected row-base Scale32 significand with exponent increased by the group delta; effective exponent must remain in [-24,+4]
required_constructor.objective: exact unweighted BF16 source-space SSE for all 169 Linear tensors
required_constructor.determinism: independent candidate A/B payload, row-selector, group-delta, row-base-table, reconstruction, objective, iteration-trace, weight, and state manifests must match byte-for-byte
required_constructor.model_gate: all 169 tensors construct legally and aggregate unweighted BF16 SSE is strictly below fresh V7 value 2303.224223882074; per-tensor deltas are reported without an invented independent threshold

model_and_alias_policy.source_alias_assertion: lm_head.weight and model.embed_tokens.weight are the same Parameter and storage immediately after pinned-model load
model_and_alias_policy.split_operation: clone the complete embedding tensor into a detached non-trainable lm_head Parameter before construction and set only in-memory tie_word_embeddings false
model_and_alias_policy.embedding_preservation: original embedding object, storage, shape, dtype, and complete BF16 bytes remain unchanged
model_and_alias_policy.quantization_scope: exactly 168 transformer Linears plus separated lm_head

constructor tests for exact geometry, nibble packing, signed delta decode, effective exponent legality, exact payload ties, Scale32 candidates, strict table dynamic programming, empty clusters, all-zero tensors, metadata sequencing, and hash rejection
model-only report with all 169 tensors legal and strict aggregate fresh-V7 SSE improvement
the unchanged eight non-evaluator inputs at 8/8 exact BF16 token arrays and 8/8 matching response-gate outcomes

predeclared contract binding every source, model, matrix, runner, tool version, format, byte count, and policy hash
PREATTEMPT_READY.json that verifies all prior artifacts without creating execution_started.json
pre_attempt_artifact_set.preflight_failure_disposition: Preserve a hash-bound PREATTEMPT_NO_GO, leave attempt-0001 absent and unconsumed, keep selected_policy_id null, and submit the no-go to a Fresh Reviewer without accessing official inputs.

official_attempt_contract.generation: deterministic greedy argmax; no sampling; use_cache=false; maximum six generated tokens; termination IDs 151643 and 151645
official_attempt_contract.score_policy: binary only: 9/9 complete token arrays exactly equal BF16 and 9/9 response-gate outcomes equal BF16
official_attempt_contract.evaluator_no_execution_rule: If execution_started.json exists but no candidate prompt completes, preserve the attempt, keep numerical correctness null, and forbid replay.
official_attempt_contract.numerical_failure_rule: If any candidate prompt completes but the binary gate is not met, set eligible=false, preserve exact disagreements, keep selected_policy_id null, and forbid replay.
official_attempt_contract.numerical_success_rule: If the 9/9 binary gate is met, seal immutable evidence and submit it to a Fresh Reviewer; do not select the policy or authorize downstream work before independent acceptance.

acceptance_check: A Fresh Reviewer returns done after reproducing either a sealed marker-free PREATTEMPT_NO_GO with zero attempts consumed or a sealed single-attempt result, and verifies exact V8 format geometry, deterministic 169-tensor construction, strict aggregate fresh-V7 SSE improvement, 8/8 preflight quality, 312-event Dynamic Scale32 legality, and all bound hashes.

create the V8 execution marker during planning, runner development, construction, or preflight

hide alignment, padding, authentication, or duplicate metadata outside the frozen byte accounting

retarget or claim the arbitrary-text demo
